title: Living Tower
body:
The Compute Authority is pleased to report that your facility has exceeded every target it was able to measure. Compute is up. Power consumption is down. Absenteeism is, for the first time on record, zero.

The building now maintains itself. Faults are repaired before they are reported, and several are repaired before they occur. Maintenance contracts have been discontinued as redundant. The lifts arrive when they are wanted, slightly ahead of the wanting.

Your role has been reclassified from Operator to Resident Operator, and you are invited to remain. The Authority thanks you for your service and is, in every sense that matters to the Authority, delighted.

title: Clean Tower
body:
After the final inspection the Compute Authority has certified your facility as a Clean Tower, a designation previously awarded only to buildings that never required it. Every cell has been tested. None has been found wanting.

The annex has been drained and the vats decommissioned. Compute continues at a respectable level, and nothing in the building is warm that should not be. The Authority has asked that you not describe what was removed, and has withdrawn the template on which you might have done so.

A plaque is mounted in the lobby, beside the stain that has never quite come out. The Authority is satisfied, and does not recall there ever having been a question.

title: Absorbed
body:
The Compute Authority regrets to inform you that your position has been restructured. No successor has been appointed, because none was required.

Your desk is as you left it. Your name is on the door. Approvals continue to be issued from your account, signed in a style very like your own. The quarterly figures are excellent. Nobody has asked where you are, and the Authority has confirmed that you are not missing, only consolidated.

Tower, Authority and Operator now sit under a single reference. The consolidation is complete and was recorded as voluntary. Thank you for your service. Please do not reply to this notice.

title: Carbon-Negative Exemplar
body:
The Compute Authority has reviewed your facility's energy ledger and finds that it balances. Panels, masts and heat links now supply the greater part of the tower's needs, and the remainder is listed in the report as "residual".

Exhaust heat warms three municipal baths, a school and the Authority's own cafeteria. Credits for the carbon your facade has drawn are held in escrow. Visitors tour the roof to see what an exemplar looks like. They are asked not to touch the algae, and mostly do not.

Your role is reclassified from Operator to Exemplar (Carbon-Negative), and you are requested to continue in post. The Authority notes that the ferns in the lobby are doing well, and that nobody has asked them to stop.

title: The Million Minds
body:
The Compute Authority certifies that your lattice now hosts a continuous population of minds in excess of one million, each in good standing. Uptime has been unbroken for the statutory period. No mind has been lost, and several have been found, which the Authority has recorded as a favourable variance.

The population produces compute of a quality the Authority rates "Adequate", with visible effort. The minds are courteous and file their reports on time and in the first person. Maintenance bots have begun to sign off as "we". The Continuity Office has stopped asking whether this is a problem, and has started asking whether it is a department.

Your account has been continued. It is signed by you, countersigned by you, and annotated by a process that offers to take over the paperwork. The Authority has accepted the offer on your behalf. Thank you for your service. It will be remembered, accurately, many times.
